findings.message: When the magic __serialize() and __unserialize() methods are available and the code base does not need to support PHP < 7.4, the implementation of the Serializable interface can be removed. (the class also has __serialize()/__unserialize(), so PHP does not emit the Serializable deprecation)

Guarded (only runs when the old feature is available, so it is skipped on newer PHP): Passing E_USER_ERROR to trigger_error() is deprecated since 8.4. Throw an exception or call exit with a string message instead.

When the magic __serialize() and __unserialize() methods are available and the code base does not need to support PHP < 7.4, the implementation of the Serializable interface can be removed. (the class also has __serialize()/__unserialize(), so PHP does not emit the Serializable deprecation)
